propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as the positional body argument and stores them literally, discarding the intended content, while exiting 0
an args[:min_args] slice silently drops surplus positional arguments holding the intended value, compounding the loss of flag-like tokens
multiple positional-body commands (create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) share the same footgun and require a unified guard
the guard must reject arguments beginning with - unless escaped via --, and must fail loudly rather than silently coerce or truncate
escape hatch via -- double-dash allows legitimate values starting with - to be written (e.g. rebar comment <id> -- "-starts with dash")
a substitution idiom (e.g. rebar comment <id> "$(cat file)") documents the workaround for large bodies without adding a --body-file option
